text: More tokens. More commits. Is any of it right?
Volume goes up when work goes badly too. Fixing things is activity.

Track first-turn resolution: sessions done without a correction. And rework share: the effort spent on sessions that needed one. Read them together. High resolution with rising rework means work deferred, not done.
Sensei groups its metrics by what they answer, and never shows speed without its quality companion.
Sensei. Measure right work, not more work.
